name: agent-sequence
source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as Server
    participant DB as Database
    C->>S: POST /api/login {"user": "alice", "pass": "***"}
    S->>DB: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = 'alice'
    alt user found
        DB-->>S: {id: 42, hash: "..."}
        alt password ok
            S-->>C: 200 {"token": "abc123"}
        else bad password
            S-->>C: 401 {"error": "invalid credentials"}
        end
    else not found
        DB-->>S: empty
        S-->>C: 404 {"error": "no such user"}
    end
    Note right of C: Client stores token in memory

name: state
source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Connecting : connect()
    Connecting --> Connected : handshake ok
    Connecting --> Failed : timeout
    Failed --> Idle : retry
    state Connected {
        [*] --> Waiting
        Waiting --> Streaming : data
        Streaming --> Waiting : drained
    }
    Connected --> Closing : close()
    state check <<choice>>
    Closing --> check
    check --> Idle : reconnect
    check --> [*] : done
    note right of Failed
        Backoff doubles each attempt
    end note
